about_the_game:
Welcome to Scientific Project: Optic — a captivating first-person puzzle adventure that immerses you in the heart of scientific discovery in optics. From philosophical musings on the nature of light to complex modern phenomena, this game takes you on an unforgettable journey through the evolution of optical science.

As a researcher, you'll explore the laws behind reflection, refraction, dispersion, and more, Each puzzle brings you closer to unlocking the mysteries of light, using it as your key to discovery.

In Scientific Project: Optic, you will be able to experiment with various optical instruments, lenses, and mirrors to construct the path of light rays. You will use reflection, refraction, and other laws of optics to solve complex puzzles and discover new possibilities.

Game Features:

- First-person puzzle gameplay based on real optical science.

- Unique mechanics involving the manipulation of light: reflection, refraction, dispersion.

- Experiment with mirrors, lenses, prisms, and other optical tools.

- Stylish visuals and an immersive atmosphere that brings the science of optics to life.

Your journey into optics isn’t just about solving puzzles — it's about understanding the light that shapes our world. Can you master the light?

  • Processor: Intel Core i5‑11400H / AMD Ryzen 5 5600H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, 6 GB VRAM, TGP ≥ 85 W.
  • DirectX: Version 12

  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card

  • OS: Windows 11 64‑bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7‑12700 / AMD Ryzen 7 7700
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
